paragraphs.text: The Harmony of the Gospels, Book II
Chapter 60. Of His Paying the Tribute Money Out of the Mouth of the Fish, an Incident Which Matthew Alone Mentions.

118. Matthew continues in these terms: <quote>And when they had come to Capharnaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said to him, Does not your master pay tribute? He says, Yes;</quote> and so on, down to where we read: <quote>You shall find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and you.</quote> He is the only one who relates this occurrence, after the interposition of which he follows again the order which is pursued also by Mark and Luke in company with him.

latex.p0002: 第60章 论祂从鱼口中付殿税，这是玛窦独自提及的事件
latex.p0003: 118. 玛窦接着这样记述：\Quote{他们来到\Place{葛法翁}，收殿税的人来到\Person{伯多禄}跟前，对他说：你们的师傅不纳殿税吗？他说：是的；}直到我们读到：\Quote{你必找到一块银币，拿去给他们，作为我和你的殿税。}只有他独自记载了这件事，在此事插入之后，他又遵循了与\Person{马尔谷}和\Person{路加}一起遵循的顺序。
